title: Notion - Steep learning curve and inflexible per-domain pricing tier
clean_text: Users report a steep learning curve, with database customization, page relationships, and tracking automation requiring meaningful exploration before mastery. Notion is described as good enough for project management for most teams but not a replacement for tools like Jira or ClickUp when execution depth matters, and integrations are seen as limited. Pricing is criticized for lacking flexibility: there is one tier per user and everyone on a workspace's domain is billed at the same tier, even when reviewers estimate only around 20% of a team uses it regularly. Some users also report slow or inconsistent support response times.
